primary_method.name: DCF
primary_method.reasoning: Celestica produces positive and growing free cash flow with an AI-server-driven revenue ramp, so an FCFF DCF is appropriate. The key tension is that an EMS cost structure caps margins, so an EV/EBITDA cross-check against manufacturing-services peers disciplines the rich post-run multiple.

wacc.reasoning: Ke = 4.3% Rf + 1.60 beta x 5.0% ERP = 12.3%. High beta for EMS cyclicality, thin margins and customer concentration. Low net debt keeps WACC near Ke at ~11.5%.
wacc.adjudication_notes: 11.5% is upper-band for the equity risk in a thin-margin, concentrated EMS.

terminal_growth.reasoning: 3.0% terminal: contract manufacturing is a GDP-plus business at best once the AI build matures; no durable pricing power to justify more.

fcf_projections.rationale: FY26E +20%: CCS (Connectivity & Cloud Solutions) hyperscaler hardware and 800G switching drive the ramp; ATS (Advanced Tech) steadier. Thin EMS margins by nature.
+16.7%: HPS (hardware platform solutions) and custom AI server programs scale; modest margin lift from mix and scale.
+13%: design-win-led growth with one to two anchor hyperscalers; operating margin grinds toward 7%.
+10%: growth normalizes as the AI build matures; margin near 7.5%.
+9%: steady compounding, low-8s operating margin (high for an EMS).

cross_check.name: Multiple
cross_check.reasoning: EV/EBIT cross-check against the EMS/ODM peer set. Even a generous re-rate multiple for an electronics-manufacturing-services company sits far below where the AI-fueled run has taken the shares.

inputs.reasoning: 14x applied to FY26E EBITDA of ~$1.0B. Double the historical EMS multiple, granted for the AI-mix shift; still implies a value well below spot.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.probability_reasoning: A heavy 30%. EMS is a thin-margin, customer-concentrated, cyclical business; CLS trades at ~4x sales versus a historical ~0.4x. A single hyperscaler program loss or capex pause re-rates it violently.
scenarios.reasoning: Hyperscaler hardware orders digest, customer concentration bites, and the multiple collapses back toward EMS norms.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Central case. CCS keeps winning AI server and networking programs and margins grind up, but the valuation already prices a chip-like trajectory onto an EMS cost structure.
scenarios.reasoning: Steady design-win-led growth decelerating from 20% to mid-single-digits, operating margin grinding from 6% to low-8s.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Low odds. Requires CLS to become a structurally higher-margin design partner (HPS/ODM mix) and to add multiple anchor hyperscalers.
scenarios.reasoning: Celestica re-rates as a design-led AI infrastructure partner rather than a contract assembler; margins and growth beat the base path.

weights_reasoning: Bear gets a full 30% because an EMS at ~4x sales is historically extreme and customer concentration plus capex cyclicality are concrete near-term risks. Base 40% for continued AI program wins. Bull only 10% because a durable margin re-rate is hard for a contract assembler. Cross-check 20% anchors against manufacturing-services norms.
